<tool_call>

- {"read": {"path": "inputs/example.csv"}}

<tool_call>
{"tool": "...", "args": {...}}

{"content":"# Overview

This report documents the reproducible data analysis pipeline for evaluating urban mobility and livability indicators across European cities. The pipeline integrates Eurostat statistical data, GTFS public transit feeds, and Wikidata points of interest to produce accessibility scores, city indicator matrices, and cluster-based profiles. All processing steps are deterministic and rely exclusively on the provided input files, with no live API access or external data retrieval.

# Input data

The pipeline consumed several input datasets stored under the `inputs/` directory. Eurostat city-level indicator values were loaded from `inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv` (657 KB), supplemented by indicator descriptions from `inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv` and metadata tables from `inputs/eurostat/metadata_tables.csv`. A sample GTFS feed for the Alicante area was provided in `inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip` (28 KB). Points of interest were sourced from `inputs/wikidata/wikidata_pois_sample.json` (12 KB), with configuration in `inputs/wikidata/city_config.json`. The Data.europa mobility catalog sample (`inputs/catalog/dataeuropa_mobility_catalog_sample.json`, 12 KB) was also available for context.

# Methods

The pipeline proceeded through fourteen sequential stages. Selected indicators were chosen from Eurostat based on mobility, population density, environment, and living conditions themes (`outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv`). Raw Eurostat data was loaded and parsed (`outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv`). GTFS data was extracted and summarized (`outputs/t04_gtfs_summary.json`), then cleaned by removing invalid coordinates, duplicates, and filling missing stop names (`outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv`, `outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv`, `outputs/t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json`). Stop service intensity was computed by counting departures and routes per stop (`outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv`). A SPARQL query was generated for Wikidata POI retrieval (`outputs/t07_query.sparql`). POIs were cleaned (`outputs/t08_pois_clean.csv`) and matched to their nearest transit stop (`outputs/t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv`). Accessibility scores combining distance and service intensity were calculated (`outputs/t10_accessibility_scores.csv`). A city indicator matrix was assembled (`outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv`), missingness was assessed (`outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv`), and a selected matrix with retained indicators was produced (`outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv`). Finally, K-means clustering was applied to group cities (`outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv`) and cluster profiles were summarized (`outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv`). Validation checks confirmed all outputs met quality criteria (`outputs/t14_validation_summary.json`).

# Generated outputs

The pipeline produced fourteen artifacts under `outputs/`. Key intermediate files include `outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv` (319 KB of raw Eurostat data), `outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv` (catalog metadata), `outputs/t04_gtfs_summary.json` (GTFS structural summary with 409 stops, 25 routes, 80 trips, and 1893 stop times), and `outputs/t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json` (cleaning report showing 1 invalid coordinate removed, 1 duplicate stop removed, and 1 missing stop name filled). The cleaned GTFS data comprises `outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv` (407 stops) and `outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv` (1892 records). Points of interest are in `outputs/t08_pois_clean.csv` (48 POIs) and their nearest-stop matches in `outputs/t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv`. Final analytical outputs include `outputs/t10_accessibility_scores.csv` (48 accessibility scores), `outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv` (1612 city-year records), `outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv` (1612 records after missingness filtering), `outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv` (1612 cluster assignments across 3 clusters), and `outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv` (profile summaries for 3 clusters).

# Main results

The accessibility analysis produced 48 scores for points of interest in the Alicante area, with values ranging from approximately 0.14 to 0.87. POI types included libraries, museums, monuments, art galleries, and theatre buildings. Monuments and libraries tended to have moderate to high accessibility scores, while some distant POIs scored lower.
